description: Archived pre-injection candidate lists for the 160-record construction audit. These lists were built gold-blind, before any target insertion, from construction_audit/input_160.json and DATA1/omd_ontology_v2.json using DATA1/build_candidates_A_v2.py (hops=2, target_size=50). The permutation distribution in this package is computed from these archived lists and does not rebuild the candidate pool.

build_environment.note: These lists reproduce the manuscript permutation figures (replay 28/160; exact mean 27.41). Within Python 3.9.6, PYTHONHASHSEED values 0, 1, 42 and unset produced identical lists (order and membership). A live rebuild under a different Python or NumPy version can change list membership and must not replace this archive.
